fields.label: Type
fields.description: Choose which database objects one category includes. AllItems includes all Items records; RegularItems and KeyItems select normal and key items; HiddenItemA/B select hidden item types. AllWeapons/AllArmors select equipment. Consumable/Nonconsumable filter item consumability. AlwaysUsable means occasion Always; BattleUsable includes Always and Battle; FieldUsable includes Always and Menu; NeverUsable means occasion Never.
fields.context: WType:x and AType:x match a weapon/armor type ID or exact Database Types name. EType:x matches equipment type: a numeric ID can include weapons and armors, while the named form selects armors. Use forms such as WType:1 or Category:Healing. Category:x matches the case-insensitive trimmed name in an object category note (see IE-NT-categories). Blank suggestions are editor separators, not useful categories; unknown strings match no objects. Set an existing zero-based array index, or replace the complete list to add an entry. Use numeric WType/AType/EType forms when a visible database type name is needed: the built-in label resolver derives type labels from numeric selectors. Category:x displays x; configured vocabulary can be replaced by an active localization entry.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Use an icon index from this game's img/system/IconSet.png for the category. Index 0 omits the icon. Choose the index in the MZ icon picker for the game's IconSet.
fields.context: Use a nonnegative whole-number icon index present in the game asset. The CLI accepts finite numbers without checking the image bounds. Categories Style text ignores the icon; icon displays only the icon, iconText displays it with the category label, and auto chooses based on available width. The referenced asset is prepared by the game author.

fields.label: Visibility Switch

fields.label: Sorted By

fields.description: NEW label text color: use a hex string such as #ff8800 or a numeric text-color index from this game's window skin.

fields.description: Pixel size of the NEW! marker text, stored as a numeric string. For example, use the JSON string "18" for an 18-pixel font; use a positive size that fits the marker bitmap.

fields.label: Fade Limit
fields.description: Upper bound of the NEW label's opacity animation counter. It reverses at this bound and at zero. Display opacity saturates at 255, so a higher bound such as 360 creates a fully opaque pause.

fields.label: Fade Speed
fields.description: Opacity-counter change per frame for the NEW label pulse. A positive value controls its speed; zero stops the pulse. The direction reverses at zero and Fade Limit.

fields.description: Horizontal offset in pixels of the NEW! marker. Positive values move it right; negative values move it left. The ordinary origin is the left edge of the item line rectangle. With VisualItemInv 1.08 enabled, the origin is the enlarged cell top-left.

fields.label: Offset Y
fields.description: Vertical offset in pixels of the NEW! marker. Positive values move it down; negative values move it up. The ordinary origin vertically centers the 32-pixel marker in the item line. With VisualItemInv 1.08 enabled, the origin is the enlarged cell top-left.
